(module
  ;; Arity-specific CALL transfer. Disable MIR inlining to keep every call.
  (func $zero (result i32) i32.const 7)
  (func $one (param i32) (result i32) local.get 0)
  (func $two (param i32 i32) (result i32)
    local.get 0 local.get 1 i32.add)
  (func $three (param i32 i32 i32) (result i32)
    local.get 0 local.get 1 i32.add local.get 2 i32.sub)
  (func $four (param i32 i32 i32 i32) (result i32)
    local.get 0 local.get 1 i32.add local.get 2 i32.sub local.get 3 i32.add)

  (func (export "empty_loop") (param $rounds i32) (param $seed i32) (result i32)
    (local $x i32)
    local.get $seed local.set $x
    block $done
      loop $repeat
        local.get $rounds i32.eqz br_if $done
        
        local.get $rounds i32.const 1 i32.sub local.set $rounds
        br $repeat
      end
    end
    local.get $x)

  (func (export "call_zero") (param $rounds i32) (param $seed i32) (result i32)
    (local $x i32)
    local.get $seed local.set $x
    block $done
      loop $repeat
        local.get $rounds i32.eqz br_if $done
        local.get $x call $zero i32.add local.set $x
        local.get $rounds i32.const 1 i32.sub local.set $rounds
        br $repeat
      end
    end
    local.get $x)

  (func (export "call_one") (param $rounds i32) (param $seed i32) (result i32)
    (local $x i32)
    local.get $seed local.set $x
    block $done
      loop $repeat
        local.get $rounds i32.eqz br_if $done
        local.get $x call $one local.set $x
        local.get $rounds i32.const 1 i32.sub local.set $rounds
        br $repeat
      end
    end
    local.get $x)

  (func (export "call_two") (param $rounds i32) (param $seed i32) (result i32)
    (local $x i32)
    local.get $seed local.set $x
    block $done
      loop $repeat
        local.get $rounds i32.eqz br_if $done
        local.get $x i32.const 1 call $two local.set $x
        local.get $rounds i32.const 1 i32.sub local.set $rounds
        br $repeat
      end
    end
    local.get $x)

  (func (export "call_three") (param $rounds i32) (param $seed i32) (result i32)
    (local $x i32)
    local.get $seed local.set $x
    block $done
      loop $repeat
        local.get $rounds i32.eqz br_if $done
        local.get $x i32.const 4 i32.const 1 call $three local.set $x
        local.get $rounds i32.const 1 i32.sub local.set $rounds
        br $repeat
      end
    end
    local.get $x)

  (func (export "call_four") (param $rounds i32) (param $seed i32) (result i32)
    (local $x i32)
    local.get $seed local.set $x
    block $done
      loop $repeat
        local.get $rounds i32.eqz br_if $done
        local.get $x i32.const 4 i32.const 1 i32.const 3 call $four local.set $x
        local.get $rounds i32.const 1 i32.sub local.set $rounds
        br $repeat
      end
    end
    local.get $x)
)

patches.lib/wardite/efflorescence/ir.rb:
diff --git a/lib/wardite/efflorescence/ir.rb b/lib/wardite/efflorescence/ir.rb
index 5d9d96c..62e8e2a 100644
--- a/lib/wardite/efflorescence/ir.rb
+++ b/lib/wardite/efflorescence/ir.rb
@@ -230,19 +230,36 @@ module Wardite
         @callee = callee
         @arguments = arguments
         @pool_index = callee.index
+        @argument_count = arguments.size
+        @argument0 = arguments.size > 0 ? arguments.fetch(0) : -1
+        @argument1 = arguments.size > 1 ? arguments.fetch(1) : -1
+        @argument2 = arguments.size > 2 ? arguments.fetch(2) : -1
       end
 
-      # Keep the generic argument loop out of the interpreter's live locals.
-      # The common single-argument path copies directly from the CALL operand.
+      # Keep multi-argument transfer out of the interpreter's live locals.
+      # Small arities use cached register indices; only larger calls loop.
       # @rbs target: Array[Integer]
       # @rbs source: Array[Integer]
       # @rbs return: void
       def copy_arguments(target, source)
-        argument = 0
-        count = @arguments.size
-        while argument < count
-          target[argument] = source[@arguments.fetch(argument)]
-          argument += 1
+        case @argument_count
+        when 0
+          # Flat zero-argument CALLs bypass this method altogether.
+        when 1
+          target[0] = source[@argument0]
+        when 2
+          target[0] = source[@argument0]
+          target[1] = source[@argument1]
+        when 3
+          target[0] = source[@argument0]
+          target[1] = source[@argument1]
+          target[2] = source[@argument2]
+        else
+          argument = 0
+          while argument < @argument_count
+            target[argument] = source[@arguments.fetch(argument)]
+            argument += 1
+          end
         end
       end
     end
patches.lib/wardite/efflorescence/optimizer.rb:
diff --git a/lib/wardite/efflorescence/optimizer.rb b/lib/wardite/efflorescence/optimizer.rb
index 0487256..c1d3a64 100644
--- a/lib/wardite/efflorescence/optimizer.rb
+++ b/lib/wardite/efflorescence/optimizer.rb
@@ -473,10 +473,10 @@ module Wardite
                 index += 1
               end
               b = calls.size
-              # The fourth slot is already decoded on every dispatch. A single
-              # argument can name its source here, bypassing the argument table
-              # and loop; -1 selects the generic zero/multiple-argument path.
-              c = arguments.size == 1 ? arguments.fetch(0) : -1
+              # A single source stays in the fourth word. Zero arguments use
+              # -2 to skip transfer; -1 delegates multiple arguments to the
+              # call site (unrolled for 2/3, generic for larger arities).
+              c = arguments.empty? ? -2 : (arguments.size == 1 ? arguments.fetch(0) : -1)
               calls << CallSite.new(callee, arguments)
             elsif opcode == Opcode::BR
               a *= WIDTH

@@ -338,7 +338,7 @@ module Wardite
             next_frame = pool.acquire(a)
             if c >= 0
               next_frame.registers[0] = registers[c]
-            else
+            elsif c != -2
               site.copy_arguments(next_frame.registers, registers)
             end
